description: Composite DRAEM objective: mean per-image reconstruction MSE plus Gaussian-window SSIM loss and two-class softmax focal segmentation loss (paper §3.1 Eqs. (1)-(2), §3.2 Eq. (3); official VitjanZ/DRAEM loss.py:64-156 and train_DRAEM.py:45-69).

examples.title: Train reconstruction and anomaly segmentation with DRAEM loss

name: DRAEM composite reconstruction and segmentation loss

parameters.additional parameters: original, reconstruction, ssim_weight, gamma, smooth, and ssim_window_size only; unsupported parameters raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because DRAEM binary anomaly masks do not support ignored pixels
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite raw two-class segmentation logits with shape [B, 2, H, W]
parameters.original: finite clean floating-point image tensor shaped [B, C, H, W], matching reconstruction dtype and device and logits batch and spatial dimensions
parameters.reconstruction: finite reconstructed floating-point image tensor with the same [B, C, H, W] shape, dtype, and device as original
parameters.reduction: none returns one total objective per image, mean averages images, or sum totals images (default mean)
parameters.smooth: positive focal target smoothing value in (0, 0.5] used for clamping the two-class one-hot mask and added to p_t (default 1e-5)
parameters.ssim_weight: finite nonnegative multiplier for the SSIM reconstruction term (default 1.0)
parameters.ssim_window_size: positive odd Gaussian SSIM window size with sigma 1.5 (default 11)
parameters.targets: binary anomaly mask with shape [B, H, W] or [B, 1, H, W], containing only 0 and 1 values
